recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-13868 unless a future OO decision changes the ServiceRequest.category example value set itself.
issue_request: FHIR-13868 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request against STU3 ProcedureRequest asking to add an example value set binding for ProcedureRequest.category, with SNOMED CT category concepts for laboratory, imaging, counselling, education, and surgical procedure.
initial_application: Historical commit 3e18984e30ed835567e78db17f64f14710e46e74, whose subject includes GF#13868, added the ServiceRequestCategory binding to the ServiceRequest category spreadsheet source, created valueset-servicerequest-category.xml with the requested SNOMED CT concepts, and recorded #13868 in the category element committee notes.
additional_context: ProcedureRequest is not an active current-build resource; source/fhir.ini records it as merged into ServiceRequest, while ServiceRequest is active. Current ServiceRequest.category binds with example strength to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/servicerequest-category, and the value set contains the requested SNOMED CT codes. A 2018 Zulip implementer thread confirms the practical migration language that ProcedureRequest.category became ServiceRequest.category in R4. Direct FHIR-13868 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active current source already carries the requested category binding and value set on the successor ServiceRequest artifact.
